download_model_from_zoo: download a PyTouch model from the S3 zoo bucket by model name and sensor type
load_model_from_zoo: load a PyTouch model state dict from the S3 zoo by model name and sensor
load_onnx_from_zoo: download and load an ONNX model from the PyTouch zoo as an InferenceSession
list_models: list all available model keys in the PyTouch S3 zoo bucket
load_onnx_session: load an ONNX model file from disk and return an ONNX Runtime InferenceSession
